news:
Welcome to the Renown Realm!

NEW on the Barrens Front (levels 1-19):
- Warbands: call up to 4 soldiers into your party (/warband)
- Field orders, supply caravans and standard-bearers
- Hero champions with bounties, Nemesis rivalries
- Announcer, MVPs, session reports (.renown session)
- Underdog bonus and spawn protection

Also: war boards, Renown ranks and loot bags, PvP XP, Human Hunters, field mount (/fm).

Click the banner button in game for the PvP panel.
